summary: Union County lookout site at 1,964 ft; the Tennessee list says the tower moved to Maynardville, likely the Hinds Ridge tower.

facts.status_note: The Tennessee list marks the tower moved, with the remark 'moved to Maynardville'. The register's Maynardville tower is on Hinds Ridge; the match is probable, not confirmed.

events.note: The Tennessee list marks the tower moved, with the remark 'moved to Maynardville'. No year is given.
The National Historic Lookout Register registered the Maynardville Fire Tower on September 28, 2015. The register does not mention Walker Ford.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 1,716 ft for the Maynardville Fire Tower. The list gives 1722' for its separate Maynardville entry. Not resolved; the story reports both figures.

The list says the Walker Ford tower moved to Maynardville. The register describes one Maynardville tower on Hinds Ridge. No source names that tower as the one moved from Walker Ford, so the story calls the match probable.

sources.title: TN lookout tower: UNT002 Walker Ford

notes_for_editor: Brief status (relocated) and elevation (598.6 m, which matches 1,964 ft) agree with the list. No source reached describes the Walker Ford site today. The Maynardville link is an inference: the list's remark names only the town, and the register describes one Maynardville tower on Hinds Ridge without mentioning Walker Ford. No build date, agency, staffing or fire history for Walker Ford appears in the sources reached, so the story leaves them out. A search snippet mentioned a Facebook post about an old Maynardville tower; it was not read and is not used. Search snippets also surfaced a historic Walker's Ford crossing on the Clinch River; nothing links that place to this tower, so it is not used. Access is not stated for either site, so no access fact is recorded. Worth a follow-up with Tennessee Division of Forestry records if the move date matters.
